title: Geometric isomer test
hints: Examine the two substituents on each double-bond carbon.
Both ends must have distinguishable substituents.
Compare the result with each choice and check its sign, units, or underlying rule.
solution: In 2-butene each alkene carbon carries H and methyl, so different relative methyl positions give cis and trans forms.
statement:
Which molecule can have cis/trans geometric isomers about its double bond?

[_]{a}

explanations: Both double-bond carbons have different substituents.
Each double-bond carbon carries two identical H atoms.
The terminal double-bond carbon carries two H atoms.
